item.tib: mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum gyi phyag bzhes dri med shel gyi skas gdang
item.coloph: ces mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum sgrub pa'i phyag bzhes 'di ni/ khri chen rin po che mchog nas gter dpe zab mo 'di dang lha reg rin 'khor gyi rten bcas cha lag 'bri dgos kyi bka' mngag bcas te/ stag btsun rad na wer zhi ched gnyer mngag phebs byung ba dang / phran bla brang gi 'char can rnams sgrab pa'i g.yang bskor dang ser bam gdong 'dzol byung bas/ mngon sum tshad ma'i rtags rten shin tu dge bas yid drangs te/ dad dang mos pa'i sgo nas bri 'dun bgyis rung / mchog dman du mas bka' mngag re don sna tshogs kyis brel bas phyir 'gyang song bar/ zhang po nyi ma rin po che nas/ rtsa gsum phyag bzhes su rgyan mchod kha bskang phyag mchod bcas tshud pa zhig 'phral grub dgos bka' nan pheb pa dang / de mtshungs dbus phug bla ma rkyang 'phags bla ma rgyal ba blo gros nas kyang gsung bskul pheb par rten nas/ deng skabs byed sgo du mas g.yeng bas/ blo bag phebs pa'i dal khams ma mchis rung / nang nub sgron me'i ngos tshul rnam brel gyi bar bsengs su smon rgyal sems ming pa/ gzhan phan g.yung drung 'byung gnas su 'bod pas/ chu sbrul dbo zla'i dga' ba gsum pa'i dral tshes phyi ma rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i skabs su mthar son bgyis pa dge'o/ bkra shis mthar rgyas bstan 'di yongs khyab shog/
